verses.text: Moab rebel against Israel after Ahab die.
Ahaziah fall down through di lattice for im upper room for Samaria and e sick. E send messengers and talk to dem say, “Go ask Baal Zebub, di god of Ekron, whether I go recover from dis sickness.”

But di angel of di Lord talk to Elijah from Tishbe say, “Stand up, go up to meet di messengers of di king of Samaria and tell dem say, ‘Na because God no dey for Israel una dey go ask Baal Zebub, di god of Ekron?’
So now di Lord talk say, ‘You no go come down from di bed wey you climb go, but you go die for sure.’” Elijah go.
Di messengers return to am, and e talk to dem say, “Why una don return?”

Dem talk to am say, “One man come up to meet us and talk to us say, ‘Go, return to di king wey send una and tell am, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Na because God no dey for Israel you dey send go ask Baal Zebub, di god of Ekron? So you no go come down from di bed wey you climb go, but you go die for sure.’”’”
E talk to dem say, “Wetin kind man be di one wey come up to meet una and tell una dis words?”
Dem answer am say, “Na hairy man e be, and e tie leather belt round im waist.” E talk say, “Na Elijah from Tishbe.”
Den di king send captain of 50 with im 50 go meet am. E go up to am, and look, e dey sit for di top of di hill. E talk to am say, “You man of God, di king don talk say, ‘Come down.’”
Elijah answer di captain of 50 say, “If I be man of God, make fire come down from di sky and burn you and your 50.” Fire come down from di sky and burn am and im 50.
Again e send another captain of 50 with im 50 go meet am. E answer am say, “You man of God, di king don talk say, ‘Come down quick.’”
Elijah answer dem say, “If I be man of God, make fire come down from di sky and burn you and your 50.” God fire come down from di sky and burn am and im 50.

Again e send di captain of third 50 with im 50. Di third captain of 50 go up, come kneel before Elijah, beg am and talk to am say, “You man of God, make my life and di life of dis 50 your servants dey precious for your eyes.
Look, fire come down from di sky and burn di two captains of 50 wey come before with dem 50, but now make my life dey precious for your eyes.”
Di angel of di Lord talk to Elijah say, “Go down with am. No fear am.” E stand up and go down with am to di king.

E talk to am say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Because you send messengers to go ask Baal Zebub, di god of Ekron, na because God no dey for Israel to ask im word? So you no go come down from di bed wey you climb go, but you go die for sure.’”
So e die as di word of di Lord wey Elijah talk. Jehoram begin to rule for im place for di second year of Jehoram, Jehoshaphat pikin, king of Judah, because e no get pikin.
Di rest of wetin Ahaziah do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Israel?
E happen say as di Lord wan carry Elijah go up to heaven with whirlwind, Elijah go with Elisha from Gilgal.
Elijah talk to Elisha say, “Wait here, because di Lord don send me reach Bethel.” Elisha talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, and as your soul dey alive, I no go leave you.” So dem go down to Bethel.
Di prophets pikin dem wey dey Bethel come out to Elisha and talk to am say, “You know say di Lord go take your oga from over your head today?” E talk say, “Yes, I know am. Keep quiet.”
Elijah talk to am say, “Elisha, wait here, because di Lord don send me go Jericho.” E talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, and as your soul dey alive, I no go leave you.” So dem reach Jericho.
Di prophets pikin dem wey dey Jericho come near Elisha and talk to am say, “You know say di Lord go take your oga from over your head today?” E answer say, “Yes, I know am. Keep quiet.”
Elijah talk to am say, “Wait here, because di Lord don send me go Jordan.” E talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, and as your soul dey alive, I no go leave you.” Di two of dem go on.
50 men of di prophets pikin dem go and stand opposite dem for distance, and di two of dem stand by Jordan.
Elijah take im cloak, roll am up and strike di water, and di water divide to here and there, so that di two of dem cross on dry ground.
E happen say as dem don cross, Elijah talk to Elisha say, “Ask wetin I go do for you before dem take me from you.” Elisha talk say, “Make double share of your spirit dey on me.”
E talk say, “You don ask hard thing. If you see me as dem take me from you, e go be so for you, but if no, e no go be so.”
E happen say as dem still dey waka and dey talk, look, chariot of fire and horses of fire show, and e separate dem, and Elijah go up with whirlwind enter heaven.
Elisha see am, and e cry say, “My papa, my papa, di chariots of Israel and im horsemen!” E no see am again. Den e hold im own clothes and tear dem into two pieces.
E pick up Elijah cloak wey fall from am too, and go back and stand by di bank of Jordan.
E take Elijah cloak wey fall from am and strike di water and talk say, “Wia di Lord, di God of Elijah, dey?” As e strike di water too, e divide to here and there, and Elisha cross.
As di prophets pikin dem wey dey Jericho opposite am see am, dem talk say, “Elijah spirit dey rest on Elisha.” Dem come meet am and bow to di ground before am.

Dem talk to am say, “Look now, 50 strong men dey with your servants. Make dem go look for your oga, maybe di Spirit of di Lord don carry am go throw am for one mountain or for one valley.” E talk say, “Una no go send.”
As dem press am until shame catch am, e talk say, “Send.” So dem send 50 men, and dem search for three days, but dem no find am.
Dem come back to am as e dey stay for Jericho, and e talk to dem say, “I no tell una say, ‘No go’?”
Di men of di city talk to Elisha say, “Look, di place wey dis city dey nice, as my oga see, but di water bad and di land no dey give fruit.”
E talk say, “Bring new jar come for me and put salt inside.” Dem bring am to am.
E go out to di spring of di water, throw di salt inside and talk say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘I don heal dis water. Death or land wey no dey give fruit no go dey from there again.’”
So di water get healing till today, as di word of Elisha wey e talk.
E go up from there to Bethel, and as e dey go up for road, young boys come out from di city, dey laugh am and talk to am say, “Go up, you bald head! Go up, you bald head!”
E look behind am and see dem, and curse dem for di name of di Lord. Two female bears come out from di forest and tear 42 of dem young boys.
E go from there to Mount Carmel, and from there e return to Samaria.
Jehoram, Ahab pikin, begin to rule over Israel for Samaria for di 18th year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and e rule 12 years.
E do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, but no be like im papa and like im mama, because e remove di pillar of Baal wey im papa make.
Still, e hold on to di sins of Jeroboam, Nebat pikin, wey e use make Israel sin. E no leave am.
Mesha king of Moab dey keep sheep, and e dey give di king of Israel di wool of 100,000 lambs and of 100,000 rams.
But e happen say as Ahab die, di king of Moab rebel against di king of Israel.
King Jehoram go out from Samaria for dat time and gather all Israel.

E go and send to Jehoshaphat di king of Judah say, “Di king of Moab don rebel against me. You go go with me against Moab for battle?” E talk say, “I go go up. I be like you, my people like your people, my horses like your horses.”
E talk say, “Which way we go take go up?” E answer say, “Di way through di wilderness of Edom.”
So di king of Israel go, and di king of Judah, and di king of Edom, and dem waka round for seven days journey, and water no dey for di army or for di animals wey follow dem.
Di king of Israel talk say, “Ah! Because di Lord don call dis three kings together to give dem into Moab hand.”

But Jehoshaphat talk say, “Prophet of di Lord no dey here, so that we go ask di Lord through am?” One of di servants of di king of Israel answer say, “Elisha, Shaphat pikin, dey here, wey dey pour water for Elijah hands.”
Jehoshaphat talk say, “Di word of di Lord dey with am.” So di king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and di king of Edom go down to am.

Elisha talk to di king of Israel say, “Wetin me and you get to do? Go meet di prophets of your papa and di prophets of your mama.” Di king of Israel talk to am say, “No, because di Lord don call dis three kings together to give dem into Moab hand.”
Elisha talk say, “As di Lord of Armies dey alive, wey I dey stand before, if no be say I respect Jehoshaphat di king of Judah, I no go even look your face or see you.
But now bring one musician to me.” E happen say as di musician dey play, di hand of di Lord come on am.
E talk say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Make dis valley full with trenches.’
Because dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Una no go see wind, and una no go see rain, but still dat valley go full with water, and una go drink, una and una animals and una cattle.’
Dis one na small thing for di Lord eyes. E go give di Moabites into una hand too.
Una go strike every strong city and every choice city, and una go cut down every good tree, and block all springs of water, and spoil every good land with stones.”
E happen for morning, about di time of di sacrifice, say look, water come by di way of Edom, and di country fill with water.
As all di Moabites hear say di kings don come up to fight against dem, dem gather together, all wey fit wear armor and above, and stand for di border.
Dem wake up early for morning, and di sun shine on di water, and di Moabites see di water opposite dem red like blood.
Dem talk say, “Na blood be dis. Di kings don destroy demselves for sure, and dem don kill each other. So now, Moab, make we go take wetin dem leave!”
As dem reach Israel camp, di people of Israel stand up and strike di Moabites, so tay dem run before dem. Dem go forward inside di land dey strike di Moabites.

Dem destroy di cities, and every man throw im stone for every good land and fill am. Dem block all di springs of water and cut down all di good trees, until only for Kir Hareseth dem leave di stones, but di men wey get slings go round am and strike am.
As di king of Moab see say di battle too hard for am, e take 700 men wey carry sword with am to break through to di king of Edom, but dem no fit.
Den e take im eldest pikin wey go rule for im place and offer am as burnt sacrifice for di wall. Big anger fall on Israel, and dem leave am and return to dem own land.

One woman among di wives of di prophets pikin dem cry out to Elisha say, “Your servant my husband don die, and you know say your servant fear di Lord. Di one wey I owe don come to take my two pikin as slaves.”
Elisha talk to am say, “Wetin I go do for you? Tell me, wetin you get for house?” E talk say, “Your servant no get anything for house, except one pot of oil.”
Den e talk say, “Go, borrow containers from all your neighbors, even empty containers. No borrow small.
You go enter, close di door on you and on your pikin dem, and pour inside all dem containers, and you go put aside di ones wey full.”
So e go from am and close di door on am and im pikin dem. Dem bring di containers to am, and e dey pour.
E happen say as di containers full, e talk to im pikin say, “Bring another container to me.” E talk to am say, “Container no remain again.” Di oil stop.
Den e come tell di man of God. E talk say, “Go sell di oil and pay your debt, and you and your pikin dem go live on di rest.”
E happen one day say Elisha pass go Shunem, wia one important woman dey, and e press am to eat bread. So any time e pass, e dey enter there to eat bread.
E talk to im husband say, “Look now, I see say na holy man of God dey pass by us always.
Make we make small room for di roof. Make we put bed for am there, and table, and chair, and lamp stand. E go happen say as e come to us, e go enter there.”
One day e come there, and e enter di room and lie there.
E talk to Gehazi im servant say, “Call dis woman from Shunem.” As e call am, e stand before am.

E talk to am say, “Talk to am now say, ‘Look, you don take care of us with all dis care. Wetin make we do for you? You wan make we talk for you to di king or to di captain of di army?’” E answer say, “I dey stay among my own people.”
E talk say, “Wetin den make we do for am?” Gehazi answer say, “True true, e no get pikin, and im husband don old.”
E talk say, “Call am.” As e call am, e stand for di door.
E talk say, “For dis season, as di time reach, you go carry pikin for your arms.” E talk say, “No, my oga, you man of God, no lie to your servant.”
Di woman become pregnant and born one boy for dat season, as di time reach, as Elisha talk to am.
As di pikin grow, e happen one day say e go out to im papa for where di people dey harvest.
E talk to im papa say, “My head, my head.” E talk to im servant say, “Carry am go meet im mama.”
As e carry am bring am to im mama, e sit for im knees until noon, and den e die.
E go up and put am for di bed of di man of God, close di door on am and go out.
E call im husband and talk say, “Send one of di servants and one of di donkeys to me, so that I go run go meet di man of God and come back.”
E talk say, “Why you wan go meet am today? E no be new moon or Sabbath.” E talk say, “E go well.”
Den e put saddle on donkey and talk to im servant say, “Drive, and go forward. No slow down for me, except I tell you.”
So e go and reach di man of God for Mount Carmel. E happen say as di man of God see am from far, e talk to Gehazi im servant say, “Look, na di woman from Shunem dey there.
Run go meet am now and ask am, ‘Everything dey well with you? Everything dey well with your husband? Everything dey well with di pikin?’” E answer say, “Everything dey well.”

As e reach di man of God for di hill, e hold im feet. Gehazi come near to push am away, but di man of God talk say, “Leave am, because im soul dey trouble inside am, and di Lord don hide am from me and no tell me.”
Den e talk say, “I ask my oga for pikin? I no talk say, ‘No deceive me’?”

Den e talk to Gehazi say, “Tie up your clothes, take my staff for your hand and go your way. If you meet anybody, no greet am, and if anybody greet you, no answer am. Put my staff on di face of di pikin.”
Di pikin mama talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, and as your soul dey alive, I no go leave you.” E stand up and follow am.
Gehazi pass before dem and put di staff on di face of di pikin, but voice no dey, and hearing no dey. So e return to meet am and tell am say, “Di pikin no wake.”
As Elisha reach di house, look, di pikin don die and dem put am for im bed.
So e enter, close di door on di two of dem and pray to di Lord.
E go up and lie on di pikin, put im mouth on im mouth, im eyes on im eyes, im hands on im hands, and e stretch imself on am, and di pikin body begin dey warm.
Den e return and waka for di house one time to and fro, and go up and stretch imself on am. Di pikin sneeze seven times, and di pikin open im eyes.
E call Gehazi and talk say, “Call dis woman from Shunem.” So e call am. As e come to am, e talk say, “Carry your pikin.”
Den e enter, fall for im feet, bow to di ground, carry im pikin and go out.
Elisha come back to Gilgal. Hunger dey for di land, and di prophets pikin dem dey sit before am, and e talk to im servant say, “Put di big pot for fire and cook soup for di prophets pikin dem.”
One go out to di field to gather leaves, find wild vine and gather wild gourds from am until im cloth full, come and slice dem enter di pot of soup, because dem no know dem.
So dem pour am out for di men to eat. E happen say as dem dey eat di soup, dem cry out and talk say, “Man of God, death dey for di pot!” Dem no fit eat am.
But e talk say, “Den bring flour.” E throw am inside di pot and talk say, “Pour am out for di people, make dem eat.” Harm no dey for di pot again.
One man come from Baal Shalishah and bring bread of di first fruits give di man of God, 20 loaves of barley and fresh grain for im sack. E talk say, “Give di people make dem eat.”
Im servant talk say, “Wetin, make I put dis before 100 men?” But e talk say, “Give di people make dem eat, because dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Dem go eat, and some go remain.’”
So e put am before dem, and dem eat and leave some, as di word of di Lord.
Naaman, captain of di army of di king of Syria, na big man with im oga and honorable, because through am di Lord give victory to Syria. E be strong and brave man too, but e get leprosy.
Di Syrians don go out for groups and carry one small girl as prisoner from Israel land, and e dey serve Naaman wife.
E talk to im madam say, “I wish say my oga dey with di prophet wey dey Samaria! Den e go heal am of im leprosy.”
Somebody enter and tell im oga say, “Di girl wey come from Israel land talk so.”
Di king of Syria talk say, “Go now, and I go send letter to di king of Israel.” E go, and e carry ten talents of silver, 6,000 pieces of gold and ten sets of clothes with am.
E bring di letter to di king of Israel say, “Now as dis letter reach you, look, I don send Naaman my servant to you, so that you go heal am of im leprosy.”

E happen say as di king of Israel read di letter, e tear im clothes and talk say, “I be God, to kill and to make alive, say dis man dey send to me make I heal man of im leprosy? But make una think am well and see how e dey look for quarrel against me.”

E happen say as Elisha di man of God hear say di king of Israel don tear im clothes, e send to di king say, “Why you tear your clothes? Make am come to me now, and e go know say prophet dey for Israel.”
So Naaman come with im horses and with im chariots and stand for di door of Elisha house.
Elisha send messenger to am say, “Go wash for Jordan seven times, and your flesh go come back to you, and you go clean.”
But Naaman vex and go, and talk say, “Look, I think say, ‘E go come out to me for sure, stand, call di name of di Lord im God, wave im hand over di place and heal di leper.’
Abanah and Pharpar, di rivers of Damascus, no better pass all di waters of Israel? I no fit wash for dem and clean?” So e turn and go with anger.
Im servants come near and talk to am say, “My papa, if di prophet ask you to do big thing, you no go do am? How much more now as e talk to you say, ‘Wash, and clean’?”
Den e go down and dip imself seven times for Jordan, as di word of di man of God, and im flesh come back like di flesh of small pikin, and e clean.
E return to di man of God, e and all im group, come stand before am and talk say, “Look now, I know say no God dey for all di earth, except for Israel. So now, take gift from your servant.”
But e talk say, “As di Lord dey alive, wey I dey stand before, I no go receive any.” E press am to take am, but e refuse.
Naaman talk say, “If no, make dem give your servant earth wey two mules fit carry, because from now your servant no go offer burnt sacrifice or sacrifice to other gods, but to di Lord.

For dis one thing make di Lord forgive your servant: as my oga enter di house of Rimmon to worship there and e lean on my hand, and I bow for di house of Rimmon, as I bow for di house of Rimmon, make di Lord forgive your servant for dis thing.”
E talk to am say, “Go in peace.” So e leave am small distance.

But Gehazi, di servant of Elisha di man of God, talk say, “Look, my oga don spare dis Naaman from Syria, as e no receive from im hand wetin e bring. As di Lord dey alive, I go run follow am and take something from am.”
So Gehazi follow Naaman. As Naaman see somebody dey run follow am, e come down from di chariot to meet am and talk say, “Everything dey well?”

E talk say, “Everything dey well. My oga don send me say, ‘Look, just now two young men from di prophets pikin dem don come to me from Ephraim hill country. Give dem one talent of silver and two sets of clothes.’”
Naaman talk say, “Agree take two talents.” E press am, tie two talents of silver for two bags with two sets of clothes and put dem on two of im servants, and dem carry dem before am.
As e reach di hill, e take dem from dem hand and keep dem for di house, and e let di men go, and dem go.
But e enter and stand before im oga. Elisha talk to am say, “Wia you come from, Gehazi?” E talk say, “Your servant no go anywhere.”

E talk to am say, “My heart no follow you, as di man turn from im chariot to meet you? Na time to receive money, and to receive clothes, and olive farms and vineyards, and sheep and oxen, and men servants and women servants?
So Naaman leprosy go hold you and your children forever.” E go out from im presence with leprosy, white like snow.
Di prophets pikin dem talk to Elisha say, “Look now, di place wia we dey stay before you too small for us.
Make we go Jordan, and each man take one beam from there, make we make place for us there wia we go stay.” E answer say, “Go.”
One talk say, “Agree make you go with your servants.” E answer say, “I go go.”
So e go with dem. As dem reach Jordan, dem cut down wood.
But as one dey cut beam, di axe head fall inside di water, and e cry out say, “Ah, my oga! Because dem borrow am.”
Di man of God talk say, “Wia e fall?” E show am di place. E cut one stick, throw am there and make di iron float.
E talk say, “Take am up for yourself.” So e stretch out im hand and take am.
Di king of Syria dey war against Israel, and e ask im servants for advice say, “My camp go dey for dis and dis place.”
Di man of God send to di king of Israel say, “Take care make you no pass dis place, because di Syrians dey come down there.”
Di king of Israel send to di place wey di man of God tell am and warn am about, and e save imself there, no be one time or two times.
Di heart of di king of Syria trouble well well about dis thing, and e call im servants and talk to dem say, “Una no go show me which one among us dey for di king of Israel side?”
One of im servants talk say, “No, my oga di king, but Elisha, di prophet wey dey Israel, dey tell di king of Israel di words wey you dey talk for your bedroom.”
E talk say, “Go see wia e dey, so that I go send people go catch am.” Dem tell am say, “Look, e dey Dothan.”
So e send horses and chariots there, and big army, and dem come for night and surround di city.
As di servant of di man of God wake up early and go out, look, army with horses and chariots dey round di city. Im servant talk to am say, “Ah, my oga! Wetin we go do?”
E answer say, “No fear, because di ones wey dey with us plenty pass di ones wey dey with dem.”
Elisha pray and talk say, “Di Lord, open im eyes make e see.” Di Lord open di young man eyes, and e see, and look, di mountain full with horses and chariots of fire round Elisha.
As dem come down to am, Elisha pray to di Lord and talk say, “Strike dis people with blindness.” E strike dem with blindness as di word of Elisha.
Elisha talk to dem say, “Dis no be di way, and dis no be di city. Follow me, and I go bring una to di man wey una dey look for.” E lead dem go Samaria.
E happen say as dem enter Samaria, Elisha talk say, “Di Lord, open di eyes of dis men make dem see.” Di Lord open dem eyes, and dem see, and look, dem dey inside Samaria.
Di king of Israel talk to Elisha as e see dem say, “My papa, make I strike dem? Make I strike dem?”
E answer say, “You no go strike dem. You go strike dem wey you don catch with your sword and with your bow? Put bread and water before dem, make dem eat and drink and go to dem oga.”
E prepare big food for dem, and as dem don eat and drink, e send dem go, and dem go to dem oga. Di groups of Syria no come into Israel land again.
E happen after dis say Ben Hadad king of Syria gather all im army, go up and surround Samaria.
Big hunger dey for Samaria, and look, dem surround am until dem sell donkey head for 80 shekels of silver, and one fourth of kab of dove dung for five shekels of silver.
As di king of Israel dey pass for di wall, one woman cry to am say, “Help me, my oga di king!”
E talk say, “If di Lord no help you, how I go take help you? From di threshing floor, or from di winepress?”
Di king talk to am say, “Wetin dey worry you?” E answer say, “Dis woman talk to me say, ‘Give your pikin make we eat am today, and we go eat my pikin tomorrow.’
So we boil my pikin and eat am. And I talk to am for di next day say, ‘Give your pikin make we eat am,’ and e don hide im pikin.”
E happen say as di king hear di words of di woman, e tear im clothes, as e dey pass for di wall, and di people look, and look, e get sackcloth inside for im body.
Den e talk say, “Make God do me so, and more, if Elisha, Shaphat pikin, head remain for im body today.”

But Elisha dey sit for im house, and di elders dey sit with am, and di king send one man from before am, but before di messenger reach am, e talk to di elders say, “Una see how dis pikin of one murderer don send to take my head? Look, as di messenger come, close di door and hold di door well against am. Di sound of im oga feet no dey behind am?”
As e still dey talk with dem, look, di messenger come down to am, and e talk say, “Look, dis evil na from di Lord. Why I go still wait for di Lord?”

Elisha talk say, “Hear di word of di Lord. Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Tomorrow by dis time dem go sell one seah of fine flour for one shekel, and two seahs of barley for one shekel, for di gate of Samaria.’”

Den di captain wey di king dey lean on im hand answer di man of God and talk say, “Look, even if di Lord make windows for heaven, dis thing fit happen?” E talk say, “Look, you go see am with your eyes, but you no go eat from am.”
Four men wey get leprosy dey for di entrance of di gate, and dem talk to each other say, “Why we dey sit here until we die?

If we talk say, ‘We go enter di city,’ den hunger dey for di city and we go die there, and if we sit quiet here, we go die too. So come, make we surrender to di army of di Syrians. If dem save us alive, we go live, and if dem kill us, we go just die.”
Dem stand up for di evening dark to go di camp of di Syrians, and as dem reach di farthest part of di camp of di Syrians, look, nobody dey there.

Because di Lord don make di army of di Syrians hear di noise of chariots, and di noise of horses, di noise of big army, and dem talk to each other say, “Look, di king of Israel don hire di kings of di Hittites and di kings of di Egyptians against us to come attack us.”
So dem stand up run for di evening dark, and leave dem tents, and dem horses, and dem donkeys, di camp as e be, and dem run for dem life.

As dis lepers reach di farthest part of di camp, dem enter one tent, eat and drink, carry silver, and gold, and clothes from there, go hide am, den dem come back and enter another tent and carry from there too and go hide am.
Den dem talk to each other say, “We no dey do well. Today na day of good news, and we dey keep quiet. If we wait until morning light, punishment go catch us. So come, make we go tell di king house.”

So dem come and call di gatekeeper of di city, and dem tell dem say, “We come di camp of di Syrians, and look, nobody dey there, no voice of man, only di horses wey dem tie and di donkeys wey dem tie, and di tents as dem be.”
Di gatekeepers call, and dem tell am to di king house inside.

Di king stand up for night and talk to im servants say, “I go tell una now wetin di Syrians do us. Dem know say we dey hungry, so dem don go out of di camp to hide for di field, dey talk say, ‘As dem come out of di city, we go catch dem alive and enter di city.’”

One of im servants answer say, “Make some take five of di horses wey remain, wey dem leave for di city. Look, dem be like all di crowd of Israel wey remain inside am. Look, dem be like all di crowd of Israel wey don finish. Make we send and see.”
So dem take two chariots with horses, and di king send dem follow di army of di Syrians say, “Go see.”
Dem follow dem reach Jordan, and look, all di way full with clothes and things wey di Syrians throw away as dem dey hurry. Di messengers return and tell di king.
Di people go out and carry things from di camp of di Syrians. So dem sell one seah of fine flour for one shekel, and two seahs of barley for one shekel, as di word of di Lord.
Di king put di captain wey im dey lean on im hand to take care of di gate, and di people trample am for di gate, and e die, as di man of God talk, wey talk as di king come down to am.
E happen as di man of God talk to di king say, “Two seahs of barley for one shekel, and one seah of fine flour for one shekel, go dey tomorrow by dis time for di gate of Samaria,”

and dat captain answer di man of God and talk say, “Now, look, if di Lord make windows for heaven, dis kind thing fit happen?” and e talk say, “Look, you go see am with your eyes, but you no go eat from am,”
e happen so to am, because di people trample am for di gate, and e die.

Elisha don talk to di woman, wey im pikin e bring back to life, say, “Stand up and go with your house, and stay for some time for wherever you fit, because di Lord don call for hunger, and e go come on di land seven years too.”
Di woman stand up and do as di word of di man of God, and e go with im house and stay for Philistines land seven years.
E happen say as di seven years end, di woman return from Philistines land, and e go out to cry to di king for im house and for im land.
Di king dey talk with Gehazi, di servant of di man of God, say, “Tell me all di big things wey Elisha don do.”

E happen say as e dey tell di king how e bring di dead one back to life, look, di woman, wey im pikin e bring back to life, cry to di king for im house and for im land. Gehazi talk say, “My oga di king, dis na di woman, and dis na im pikin wey Elisha bring back to life.”
As di king ask di woman, e tell am. So di king give am one officer and talk say, “Return all wey belong to am, and all di fruits of di field from di day wey e leave di land till now.”
Elisha come to Damascus, and Ben Hadad di king of Syria dey sick, and dem tell am say, “Di man of God don come here.”
Di king talk to Hazael say, “Take gift for your hand, go meet di man of God and ask di Lord through am say, ‘I go recover from dis sickness?’”

So Hazael go meet am, and e carry gift with am, every good thing of Damascus, 40 camels load, and e come stand before am and talk say, “Your pikin Ben Hadad king of Syria don send me to you say, ‘I go recover from dis sickness?’”
Elisha talk to am say, “Go tell am, ‘You go recover for sure,’ but di Lord don show me say e go die for sure.”
E fix im eyes for am until shame catch am, and di man of God cry.

Hazael talk say, “Why you dey cry, my oga?” E answer say, “Because I know di evil wey you go do to Israel pikin dem. You go set dem strong places for fire, and you go kill dem young men with sword, and you go smash dem small pikin dem, and you go cut open dem pregnant women.”
Hazael talk say, “But wetin be your servant, wey be just dog, say e go do dis big thing?” Elisha answer say, “Di Lord don show me say you go be king over Syria.”
Den e leave Elisha and come to im oga, wey talk to am say, “Wetin Elisha talk to you?” E answer say, “E tell me say you go recover for sure.”
E happen for di next day say e take one cover, dip am for water and spread am on im face, so tay e die, and Hazael rule for im place.
For di fifth year of Joram, Ahab pikin, king of Israel, as Jehoshaphat still be king of Judah, Jehoram, Jehoshaphat pikin, king of Judah, begin to rule.
E be 32 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule eight years for Jerusalem.
E waka for di way of di kings of Israel, as Ahab house do, because Ahab pikin na im wife, and e do wetin bad for di Lord eyes.
Still, di Lord no wan destroy Judah, because of David im servant, as e promise am to give am lamp for im children always.
For im days Edom rebel from under Judah hand and make king for demselves.
Den Joram cross go Zair, and all im chariots with am, and e stand up for night and strike di Edomites wey surround am, and di captains of di chariots, and di people run go dem tents.
So Edom rebel from under Judah hand till today. Libnah rebel for di same time too.
Di rest of wetin Joram do, and all wey e do, dem no write dem for di book of di chronicles of di kings of Judah?
Joram die join im papa dem and dem bury am with im papa dem for David city, and im pikin Ahaziah rule for im place.
For di 12th year of Joram, Ahab pikin, king of Israel, Ahaziah, Jehoram pikin, king of Judah, begin to rule.
Ahaziah be 22 years old as e begin to rule, and e rule one year for Jerusalem. Im mama name na Athaliah, Omri pikin, king of Israel.
E waka for di way of Ahab house and do wetin bad for di Lord eyes, as Ahab house do, because e be di son in law of Ahab house.
E go with Joram, Ahab pikin, to war against Hazael king of Syria for Ramoth Gilead, and di Syrians wound Joram.

King Joram return to heal for Jezreel from di wounds wey di Syrians give am for Ramah as e fight against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah, Jehoram pikin, king of Judah, go down to see Joram, Ahab pikin, for Jezreel, because e sick.
Elisha di prophet call one of di prophets pikin dem and talk to am say, “Tie up your clothes, take dis small bottle of oil for your hand and go Ramoth Gilead.
As you reach there, look for Jehu, Jehoshaphat pikin, Nimshi pikin, and enter, make am stand up from among im brothers and carry am go inside room.
Den take di small bottle of oil, pour am on im head and talk say, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: “I don anoint you king over Israel.”’ Den open di door, run and no wait.”
So di young man, di young prophet, go Ramoth Gilead.
As e reach, look, di captains of di army dey sit, and e talk say, “I get message for you, captain.” Jehu talk say, “For which one among all of us?” E talk say, “For you, captain.”
E stand up and enter di house, and e pour di oil on im head and talk to am say, “Dis na wetin di Lord, di God of Israel, talk: ‘I don anoint you king over di people of di Lord, over Israel.
You go strike Ahab your oga house, so that I go take revenge for di blood of my servants di prophets and di blood of all di servants of di Lord from Jezebel hand.
Because all Ahab house go perish, and I go cut off from Ahab every male, di one wey dem lock up and di one wey dey free for Israel.
I go make Ahab house like Jeroboam house, Nebat pikin, and like Baasha house, Ahijah pikin.
Dogs go eat Jezebel for Jezreel land, and nobody go dey to bury am.’” E open di door and run.
Den Jehu come out to im oga servants, and one talk to am say, “Everything dey well? Why dis mad man come to you?” E talk to dem say, “Una know di man and wetin im talk be.”
Dem talk say, “Na lie, tell us now.” E talk say, “Na so and so e talk to me, say, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: “I don anoint you king over Israel.”’”
Den dem hurry, and every man take im cloth and put am under am for di top of di stairs, and dem blow di trumpet say, “Jehu na king.”
So Jehu, Jehoshaphat pikin, Nimshi pikin, plan against Joram. Joram don dey guard Ramoth Gilead, e and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria,

but King Joram don return to heal for Jezreel from di wounds wey di Syrians give am as e fight with Hazael king of Syria. Jehu talk say, “If na your mind, make nobody escape go out of di city to go tell am for Jezreel.”
So Jehu ride chariot go Jezreel, because Joram lie there. Ahaziah king of Judah don come down to see Joram.

Di watchman dey stand for di tower for Jezreel, and e see Jehu group as dem dey come and talk say, “I see one group.” Joram talk say, “Take one horseman and send am to meet dem and make e talk say, ‘Na peace?’”

So one man ride horse go meet am and talk say, “Dis na wetin di king talk: ‘Na peace?’” Jehu talk say, “Wetin you get to do with peace? Turn round and follow me.” Di watchman report say, “Di messenger reach dem, but e no dey come back.”
Den e send another one on horse, wey come to dem and talk say, “Dis na wetin di king talk: ‘Na peace?’” Jehu answer say, “Wetin you get to do with peace? Turn round and follow me.”
Di watchman report say, “E reach dem, and e no dey come back, and di way e dey drive na like Jehu, Nimshi pikin, way, because e dey drive like mad man.”

Joram talk say, “Get ready.” Dem get im chariot ready. Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah go out, each one for im chariot, and dem go out to meet Jehu and find am for Naboth land, di man from Jezreel.
E happen say as Joram see Jehu, e talk say, “Na peace, Jehu?” E answer say, “Wetin peace, as long as your mama Jezebel prostitution and witchcraft plenty so?”
Joram turn im hands, run and talk to Ahaziah say, “Betrayal dey, Ahaziah!”
Jehu draw im bow with all im strength and shoot Joram between im arms, and di arrow go out through im heart, and e sink down for im chariot.

Den Jehu talk to Bidkar im captain say, “Carry am up and throw am for di land of Naboth di man from Jezreel, because remember how as me and you ride together follow im papa Ahab, di Lord put dis load on am:

‘For sure I don see yesterday di blood of Naboth and di blood of im pikin dem,’ na so di Lord talk, ‘and I go pay you back for dis land,’ na so di Lord talk. So now carry am throw am for dat land, as di word of di Lord.”

But as Ahaziah di king of Judah see dis, e run by di way of di garden house. Jehu follow am and talk say, “Strike am too for di chariot,” and dem strike am for di climb of Gur, wey dey by Ibleam. E run go Megiddo and die there.
Im servants carry am for chariot go Jerusalem and bury am for im grave with im papa dem for David city.
For di 11th year of Joram, Ahab pikin, Ahaziah begin to rule over Judah.
As Jehu reach Jezreel, Jezebel hear am, and e paint im eyes, fix im head and look out from di window.
As Jehu enter di gate, e talk say, “Na peace, you Zimri, wey kill your oga?”
E lift im face to di window and talk say, “Who dey my side? Who?” Two or three palace officers look out at am.
E talk say, “Throw am down.” So dem throw am down, and some of im blood splash for di wall and for di horses, and e trample am under foot.
As e enter, e eat and drink, and e talk say, “See to dis cursed woman now and bury am, because na king pikin e be.”
Dem go bury am, but dem no find any more of am except di skull, and di feet, and di palms of im hands.
So dem come back and tell am. E talk say, “Dis na di word of di Lord, wey e talk by im servant Elijah from Tishbe say, ‘For Jezreel land dogs go eat Jezebel flesh,
and Jezebel body go be like dung for di face of di field for Jezreel land, so that dem no go talk say, “Dis na Jezebel.”’”
